resources.title: Floating Companion: Exploring Design Space for Soft Floating Robots in Indoor Environments
resources.author: Mingyang Xu, Yanheng Li et al.
resources.note: How buoyancy, softness, movement, and proximity shape companionship. A design framework grounded in interviews with 12 experts and proof-of-concept robots.

resources.title: Entropy of city street networks linked to future spatial navigation ability
resources.author: Antoine Coutrot et al.
resources.note: Connects the street patterns of childhood environments with later performance on navigation tasks. A study of how spatial experience relates to cognition, with findings about association rather than proof that one urban layout causes better navigation.

resources.title: ReMirrorFugue: Examining the Emotional Experience of Presence and (Illusory) Communications Across Time
resources.author: Xiao Xiao et al.
resources.note: A player piano and life-sized projections bring recorded performances into the present. A study with 28 participants examines emotional presence and the experience of illusory communication across time.

resources.title: inFORM: Dynamic Physical Affordances and Constraints through Shape and Object Actuation
resources.author: Sean Follmer, Daniel Leithinger, Alex Olwal, Akimitsu Hogge & Hiroshi Ishii
resources.note: A shape-changing surface that guides gestures, creates physical constraints, and moves objects. Explores how computation can take physical form and respond directly to the hands.

resources.title: Radical Atoms: Beyond Tangible Bits, Toward Transformable Materials
resources.author: Hiroshi Ishii, Dávid Lakatos, Leonardo Bonanni & Jean-Baptiste Labrune
resources.note: A vision of computational materials whose physical form changes with digital information. Extends Tangible Bits toward transformable matter, outlining possibilities for future interaction rather than claiming an already-realized material.

resources.title: Consciousness in Artificial Intelligence: Insights from the Science of Consciousness
resources.author: Patrick Butlin, Robert Long et al.
resources.note: A careful comparison of consciousness theories and the indicators they suggest for AI. The proposed indicators are provisional; meeting them would not establish subjective experience.

resources.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
resources.author: Joon Sung Park et al.
resources.note: Memory, retrieval, reflection, and planning tested in a simulated town. A concrete account of how past experience can shape an agent’s behavior; its evaluation concerns believability, not consciousness.

resources.title: My Digital Twin Walks the City: Decisional Symmetry in Human—Agent Urban Navigation
resources.author: Leticia Izquierdo Garcia, Miguel Ureña-Pliego, Adrian Mora-Carrero & Kent Larson
resources.note: Thirty participants and their personalized AI agents navigate the same street imagery. Comparing route choices and stated reasons reveals how matching decisions can conceal different priorities, including perceptions of safety.

resources.title: Dormio: A Targeted Dream Incubation Device
resources.topic: Paper · MIT Media Lab · Consciousness and Cognition
resources.author: Adam Haar Horowitz et al.
resources.publication: Paper · MIT Media Lab · Consciousness and Cognition
resources.note: A wearable and auditory protocol for influencing dream content at sleep onset. Opens a way to study the relationship between dreams, experience, and memory through controlled experiments.

resources.title: Tangible Bits: Towards Seamless Interfaces between People, Bits, and Atoms
resources.author: Hiroshi Ishii & Brygg Ullmer
resources.note: An enduring argument for giving information physical form. Objects, surfaces, light, and sound engage bodily skills and peripheral awareness that screens often leave unused.

resources.title: AlterEgo: A Personalized Wearable Silent Speech Interface
resources.author: Arnav Kapur, Shreyas Kapur & Pattie Maes
resources.note: A wearable interface that detects deliberately articulated silent speech and returns audio through bone conduction. Explores computing as a discreet extension of human communication.

resources.title: Humanity’s Last Machine
resources.author: Sourish Jasti, Zoey Tang, Intel Chen & Vishnu Mano
resources.note: Humanoid robots examined through their physical parts: motors, actuators, sensors, batteries, and the constraints of making them. Includes suppliers, component costs, and geopolitics.

resources.title: Ryo Lu — Notes
resources.note: Ongoing notes on software, making things, and the human side of technology.

resources.title: Cognitive Tools for Making the Invisible Visible
resources.speaker: Judy Fan
resources.note: How drawing and data visualization help people learn, communicate, and think with abstractions. Full MIT talk by Stanford’s Judy Fan.

resources.title: Learn Kernels
resources.note: An interactive GPU and kernel curriculum; useful as a technical learning reference, not a selected essay.

resources.title: Learn UI

resources.title: Billy Lynn's Long Halftime Walk

resources.title: 大佛普拉斯
resources.note: Dark comedy, surveillance footage, and a sharp eye for the distance between the powerful and the people who work for them.

resources.title: ドライブ・マイ・カー
resources.note: Rehearsal, translation, and long car journeys become ways of listening to grief without demanding that it resolve.

resources.title: 推拿

resources.title: 醉‧生夢死

resources.title: 誰も知らない

resources.title: Manchester by the Sea

resources.title: Dune

resources.title: 重慶森林
resources.note: For loneliness in a crowded city, restless motion, and the way a repeated song can turn an everyday space into a private world.

resources.title: Detachment

resources.title: Rain Man

resources.title: Сталкер

resources.title: 切腹
